title: Trimmed reads of CPL00272 (Tor) propagated on Ps. Aeruginosa PAO1
design_description: Phage DNA extracted using Norgene Phage DNA isolation kit and quanitfied using Qubit 3 with BS assay kit. Libraries prepared by Exeter Sequencing Service by barcoding and pooling and sequenced using Illumina Novaseq to generate 150 bp paired end reads.
